notes: Curated CS-PhD Co-Scientist landscape, merged from a 4-worker Grok swarm (GDM, Stanford, Sakana/FutureHouse/OpenAI, CS-agent benches). Prefer primary papers. Verify identifiers before you cite.

entries.name: Co-Scientist (execution-grounded)
entries.architecture: Three stages: ideation (TrueSkill+UCB tournament, ethics, critique, evolution), experimentation (scaffold→full evolutionary programs), paper writing (scaffold + plagiarism + hallucination clipping).
entries.results: CVD recipes for monolayer TMDs; E. coli swarm phenotype predictor; Agent_H beats 6 frontier models on length-adjusted HealthBench Hard/Pro; 30 experts / 450 reviews show integrity modules reduce hallucination and plagiarism.
entries.limitations: Gemini-centric; wet-lab still needs humans; Agent_H physician preference mixed vs autorater; MXene atomic confirmation pending.
entries.steal: Joint-opt score with λ_hall=1.0; terminate paper writing if no logs; verbose experiment logs; held-out benchmarks during architecture search.
entries.avoid: Optimizing only an LLM reviewer score (reward hacking / fabricated results).

entries.name: Co-Scientist / Towards an AI co-scientist
entries.architecture: Supervisor + Generation, Reflection, Ranking (Elo pairwise debate, initial Elo=1200), Evolution, Proximity, Meta-review. Async task framework. Test-time compute. TrueSkill+UCB is the 2608.26701 upgrade, not this paper.
entries.results: AML drug-repurposing candidates with in-vitro inhibition; liver-fibrosis epigenetic targets in organoids; unpublished AMR gene-transfer mechanism recapitulated in silico.
entries.autonomy: Scientist-supervised hypothesis engine; not closed-loop wet-lab.
entries.limitations: Hypothesis-first; imperfect factuality; enterprise preview, not a local FOSS stack.
entries.steal: Generate-debate-evolve; Reflection-with-search; proximity de-dup; seed with the expert's best guess then evolve it.

entries.name: AlphaEvolve
entries.architecture: Evolutionary program search: LLM mutates code, automatic evaluators score, island populations keep diversity.
entries.results: 4×4 complex matmul in 48 multiplies (first beat of that Strassen setting); ~20% of 50 math problems improved; production scheduling/TPU kernels (vendor-reported).
entries.autonomy: Autonomous in silico with verifiable fitness.
entries.limitations: Needs a cheap, honest evaluator. Not a paper writer.
entries.steal: Never evolve without a machine-checkable fitness. Island models.
entries.avoid: Using an LLM-as-judge as the only fitness.

entries.name: AlphaFold 3
entries.architecture: Diffusion-based biomolecular complex predictor (not an agent).
entries.results: SOTA structure prediction for proteins, nucleic acids, ligands.
entries.steal: Ground agents in specialist oracles when the domain has one.
entries.avoid: Asking a general LLM to replace AlphaFold.

entries.name: GNoME
entries.results: Orders-of-magnitude expansion of stable inorganic crystals; subset experimentally realized.

entries.name: Biomni
entries.architecture: Biomni-E1 (150 tools, 105 packages, 59 DBs mined from literature) + Biomni-A1 CodeAct planner. Code is the action interface.
entries.results: LAB-Bench DbQA 74.4% (human 74.7%); 8 held-out real-world benches +402% vs base LLM; cloning matched a postdoc; Science 2026. Field-use claims ~10k labs.
entries.autonomy: Tool-using lab copilot; human still owns wet-lab risk.
entries.limitations: LLM factuality; protocol precision; not a CS architecture searcher.
entries.steal: Mine then freeze a verified action space. Code as universal action. Hold out new task families.

entries.name: The Virtual Lab
entries.architecture: LLM principal investigator + specialist scientist agents in research meetings; human provides high-level feedback.
entries.results: Designed 92 SARS-CoV-2 nanobodies via ESM + AlphaFold-Multimer + Rosetta; experimental binders including improved JN.1/KP.3 profiles.
entries.steal: Role-specialized scientists + a PI who assigns work + specialist oracles (ESM/AF).
entries.avoid: Meetings without an artifact and a test.

entries.name: STORM
entries.architecture: Outline + multi-perspective research writing with retrieval.
entries.results: Long-form articles with citations; human eval vs vanilla RAG.
entries.avoid: Using STORM as a discovery engine.

entries.name: The AI Scientist / AI Scientist v2
entries.architecture: End-to-end ML research: idea → code → experiment → paper → automated review. v2 scales with base-model quality and test-time compute.
entries.results: v2: one ICLR workshop paper cleared then withdrawn. Nature: quality scales with base model and tree-search budget. Workshop ≠ main track.
entries.autonomy: Fully autonomous in silico ML research.
entries.limitations: High fabrication risk when fitness is an LLM reviewer (Chen 2025; Gupta & Pruthi 2025 report plagiarism up to ~24%).
entries.steal: Closed code+experiment loop; store every seed and log.
entries.avoid: Shipping papers whose numbers exist only in the prose.

entries.name: Agent Laboratory
entries.architecture: PhD / Postdoc / Professor roles that plan, code, and write ML papers.
entries.results: Co-pilot > autonomous. Human NeurIPS-style overall 3.8/10 vs automated 6.1/10. Cheap gpt-4o path. mle-solver medals on an MLE-bench subset.
entries.limitations: Same reviewer-hacking failure mode without log verification.
entries.steal: Human owns the idea; agent executes. Publish the human–auto score gap.
entries.avoid: Autonomous mode as default. Trusting LLM paper scores.
